subject: computer-science
title: Discrete vs Continuous Models
welcome_lead: Model the world in slices or smooth flows - choose your simulation style.
meta_desc: HL CS adventure on discrete vs continuous, deterministic vs stochastic models.
final_note: Choose discrete or continuous - both have trade-offs!

concepts.def: State changes at distinct events/time steps.
State changes continuously, often via ODEs.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Queue simulation: arrivals at events (discrete).

Fluid flow: governed by continuous PDEs.

Population growth dy/dt = ky is deterministic.

Adding random noise to k makes it stochastic.

Continuous models discretised via Euler or RK4.

Smaller Δt - higher accuracy, more compute.
